Hi Sara (& BrightHealth procurement),

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking through the project requirements. Per our call, attaching the Redwood vendor packet (vendor forms + sample W-9) and a short checklist to speed vendor activation. Quick recap and ask: 

- Preferred commercial path: you mentioned procurement typically uses PO numbers and a vendor portal. Can you confirm PO vs corporate card preference for this engagement?
- Billing cadence: do you invoice monthly NET30/45, or do you require consolidated monthly invoices?
- Vendor portal: if you prefer portal onboarding, please confirm the contact who will complete the portal registration and whether they need SSO parameters.
- Required paperwork: please return a completed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8 (if non-US) and banking details for ACH/wire.

Next steps I can own: send an MSA/ordering doc for signature (DocuSign), provide sample invoice template, and confirm tax remit address. Ben (CC'd) will help with the payment path and any finance questions.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v3.pdf, sample_w9_redwood.pdf

Thanks — I can be flexible for a follow-up call this week if you want to run through the forms together.

Best,

Hi Monica — thanks for the packet and the recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- Commercial path: Procurement prefers PO workflow for any subscription > $10k/month; for smaller purchases they use our corporate card. For this pilot, we expect to put Redwood on a PO.
- Billing cadence: BrightHealth typically processes consolidated monthly invoices on NET45 terms. Can Redwood accommodate NET45?
- Vendor portal: yes, we prefer portal onboarding where possible. Procurement will need a vendor portal invite and a contact to request SSO metadata if applicable.
- Paperwork: attached our completed W-9 and bank details spreadsheet (we're a US entity). Please confirm the remit-to address and the vendor name you will register.

Attached: brighthealth_completed_w9.pdf, brighthealth_bank_details.xlsx

Also: can you share a sample invoice and confirm whether Redwood invoices show usage breakouts by route/model (we need that for internal cost-allocation)?

Sara Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager, BrightHealth

procurement@brighthealth.com
